title: StockSmart Service Level Schedule — Visits, Scanning, Replenishment Timing and Billing Basis
content:
Each tier of the StockSmart Vendor-Managed Inventory Program fixes how often Corbett visits, who counts the bins, how fast replenishment reaches the bins, how replenishment is priced, freighted and invoiced, how many hours a dedicated associate staffs the storeroom, and how quickly an emergency visit is made.

| Term | Self-Scan | Monthly Service | Biweekly Service | Weekly Service | Twice-Weekly Service | Onsite Storeroom |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Scheduled service visits per calendar month | 0 | 1 | 2 | 4 | 8 | 22 (one per business day) |
| Who counts the bins and triggers replenishment | customer handheld scan | Corbett associate scan | Corbett associate scan | Corbett associate scan | Corbett associate scan | onsite associate, continuous |
| Business days from scan or visit to delivery into the bins | 2 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 0 |
| Level each replenished bin is filled to | max level | max level | max level | max level | max level | max level |
| Price at which replenished and consumed items are billed | contract price on the delivery date | contract price on the delivery date | contract price on the delivery date | contract price on the delivery date | contract price on the delivery date | contract price on the delivery date |
| Freight on replenishment | under the served ship-to's freight terms | included | included | included | included | included |
| Unit billed by one replenishment invoice | per scan order | per visit | per visit | per visit | per visit | per visit |
| Hours per week a dedicated Corbett associate staffs the storeroom | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 40 |
| Hours within which an emergency visit is made | 48 | 24 | 24 | 8 | 8 | 2 |

The column headings name the tiers StockSmart Self-Scan, StockSmart Monthly Service, StockSmart Biweekly Service, StockSmart Weekly Service, StockSmart Twice-Weekly Service and StockSmart Onsite Storeroom.

### Points of the schedule

- A visit count of 0 means the customer scans its own bins; on StockSmart Self-Scan replenishment is triggered by the customer's handheld scan order rather than by a Corbett visit.
- A staffing figure of 0 means no dedicated associate; only StockSmart Onsite Storeroom is staffed, for 40 hours a week.
- StockSmart Self-Scan is the only tier whose replenishment freight follows the served ship-to's freight terms and whose replenishment invoice covers one scan order; every other tier includes freight and invoices per visit.
